articles.title: Vertiv introduces medium-voltage power system to help AI data centers connect to the grid faster and free indoor space for compute.

articles.summary: Vertiv Holdings Co. (NYSE: VRT), a global leader in critical digital infrastructure, today introduced the Vertiv™ PowerStation 3100 RPP, a high-density remote power panel designed to help data center operators streamline power distribution for AI and high-performance computing (HPC) racks with power densities exceeding 100 kW. The solution is available now in North America.
articles.title: Vertiv introduces high-density remote power panel for next-generation AI data centers

articles.summary: Vertiv Holdings Co. (NYSE: VRT), a global leader in critical digital infrastructure, today announced a three-year strategic agreement with Infineon Technologies AG (FSE: IFX / OTCQX: IFNNY) to deepen their long-standing collaboration and support long-term reliable access to, and supply of, critical silicon (Si) and silicon carbide (SiC) power semiconductors.
articles.title: Vertiv and Infineon deepen strategic partnership for critical power infrastructure

articles.summary: At megawatt-scale rack densities, the problem is conductor volume. 800 VDC addresses this, but voltage alone is not an architecture. The real design variable is where the AC-to-DC conversion boundary sits and how that choice shapes fault domains, battery integration, and operational complexity.
articles.title: 800 VDC conversion boundary: Three architecture models for MW-scale AI data centers

articles.summary: Vertiv Holdings Co. (NYSE: VRT), a global leader in critical digital infrastructure, is proving the power, thermal management and controls infrastructure behind AI factories at the start of the engineering process, ahead of the silicon it supports, using the Vertiv ATLAS Lab, a system-level testing capability.
articles.title: Vertiv ATLAS proves AI infrastructure ahead of silicon
